user.title: Connect the WiSafe2 bridge
user.description: Connect the Arduino by USB and enter its serial device path.

data_description.port: Use a stable /dev/serial/by-id/... path when available.
data_description.baud_rate: The bridge firmware defaults to 115200 baud.
data_description.bridge_device_id: The six-digit device ID hardcoded in the Arduino firmware. The original firmware uses A5B813.

abort.already_configured: This serial bridge is already configured.

menu_options.add_device: Add a detector by hex ID

add_device.title: Add a detector
add_device.description: Enter the six-digit hex ID printed or previously configured for the detector. The optional four-digit model code will normally be learned from its next radio message.

data_description.device_type: The bridge reports both smoke and heat events as FIRE, so choose the type when known.

import_legacy_yaml.title: Import legacy package YAML
import_legacy_yaml.description: Paste the contents of the old FireAngel package. Detectors with matching event, battery, and base-status entities and the bridge's event-only WiSafe2 device will be added. Devices already configured are ignored.

error.already_configured: This detector has already been added.
error.no_devices_found: No detector definitions were found. Paste the complete legacy package YAML.
error.all_devices_configured: Every detector found in this package is already configured.
